metadata.scenario: A new client calls to schedule a consultation for allergy testing. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Eleanor Watson. I'm calling to schedule a consultation for allergy testing. Hi, Eleanor! It's great to hear from you. Allergy testing, you say? We don't provide that service directly. Oh, I see. Do you know where I could go for that? I can help you find a local clinic that specializes in allergy testing. Meanwhile, is there anything else I can assist you with? Actually, I might need some more physical therapy sessions as well. Certainly! I’ll check on the availability for our physical therapist. How many sessions are you thinking? Maybe two a week, if possible. That sounds reasonable. Let me pull up our PT schedule. In the meantime, can I get your preferred days and times for the PT sessions? I’d prefer mornings, maybe around 10 AM if that’s available. Great! I’ll note that down. Let’s also figure out allergy testing for you. Yes, please. I need to get that sorted out too. Alright, I can recommend a local allergist. They usually have a quick turnaround for appointments. That would be helpful, thank you! You're welcome! I’ll make sure to send you their contact information via email. Perfect! My email is the same as before. Got it! Now, I’ll check our PT schedule and see what we have available for you. Thank you! I really appreciate it. No problem! Just a moment while I confirm the details. Looks like we have openings on Tuesday and Thursday mornings at 10 AM. Does that work for you? Yes, that sounds great! Let’s do that. Excellent, I’ll schedule you for those sessions, starting next week. Wonderful, thank you! So to recap, you'll get two PT sessions per week, and I’ll send you the allergist’s info via email. That’s perfect! Great! Is there anything else you need today? No, I think that covers everything. Alright, Eleanor! Thank you for calling, and I hope you have a wonderful day! You too, Margaret! Thanks again. You're welcome! Goodbye! Bye!
